panels.title: Completed simulations
panels.description: Counts completion events; ordinary gameplay losses are separate from timeouts, softlocks and invalid actions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS completed, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome')='win') AS wins, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome')='loss') AS losses, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') IN ('softlock','invalid_action','timeout')) AS technical_failures FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed')

panels.title: Seed coverage
panels.description: Distinct completed seeds across policies. Repeated seeds do not increase coverage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractInt(properties,'seed')) AS distinct_seeds FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed')

SELECT concat(JSONExtractString(properties,'policy'), ' / ', if(empty(JSONExtractString(properties,'mode')), 'legacy', JSONExtractString(properties,'mode')), ' / v', toString(schema_version), ' / ', JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome')) AS result, count() AS simulations FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed') GROUP BY result ORDER BY simulations DESC, result LIMIT 40

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'card_name') AS card, count() AS plays FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='card_played') GROUP BY card ORDER BY plays DESC, card LIMIT 20

panels.title: Bot card usage
panels.description: Most played cards in the selected time range.

panels.title: Simulation outcomes over time
panels.description: Counts per adaptive time bucket; empty buckets have no bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, count() AS simulations FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed') GROUP BY time, outcome ORDER BY time, outcome

panels.title: Average duration by policy / mode / schema

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, concat(JSONExtractString(properties,'policy'), ' / ', if(empty(JSONExtractString(properties,'mode')), 'legacy', JSONExtractString(properties,'mode')), ' / v', toString(schema_version)) AS cohort, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'duration_ms')) AS duration FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed') GROUP BY time, cohort ORDER BY time, cohort

panels.title: Technical failures — seed and session
panels.description: Session IDs distinguish older reused run IDs. These rows may include victory-screen automation failures; timeout does not establish a gameplay loss.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, session_id, run_id, JSONExtractInt(properties,'seed') AS seed, JSONExtractString(properties,'policy') AS policy, JSONExtractString(properties,'mode') AS mode, schema_version, JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, JSONExtractInt(properties,'turns') AS turns, JSONExtractInt(properties,'duration_ms') AS duration_ms FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed' AND JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') NOT IN ('win','loss','aborted','replay_complete')) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT '__latest__' AS __value, 'Latest reporting build' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT build_version AS __value, build_version AS __text FROM (SELECT build_version, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY last_seen DESC, build_version DESC)
list.label: Build
list.description: Latest event timestamp for this game/environment, across sources and outside the time picker. Select a version to pin history.

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

title: AutoWalker QA
description: Defaults to the latest reporting build for the selected game/environment, across sources. Historical builds remain selectable. Panels respect the selected time range and source unless labeled global.
